description: Land Title Settlement Department - Watinapaha, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510400 (23/0977)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their ownership status, extent, and other land-related particulars. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and other land-related administrative matters.
